current_roadmap: docs/open-source-readiness-plan.md P05; current counts and exact-source blockers are in proof-attestation.json and proof-dispositions.json
policy: Every item remains body-hash-bound in proof-dispositions.json. Closing an item requires direct pinned-Verus verification or a separately reviewed, minimal native contract counted in proof-attestation.json.

workstreams.mitigation: Replace generic mutable callback helpers with concrete decoder state-machine methods or contribute stateful callable contracts to vstd.
workstreams.exit_criteria: Annex A integer and IAID helper loops directly verify with cursor/context preservation.

workstreams.surface: Standard trait, formatting, and std::io boundaries
workstreams.mitigation: Keep formatting outside algorithm proofs; directly verify Default and From implementations when pinned Verus supports these standard traits, and model stable IoErrorKind conversion only through a separately reviewed boundary contract.
workstreams.exit_criteria: All remaining Default, From, formatting, and I/O conversion functions have direct contracts or an approved native-boundary disposition.

workstreams.mitigation: Introduce verified deterministic resource stores and concrete page-sink adapters, replacing HashMap and trait-callback proof dependencies.
workstreams.exit_criteria: Page/resource insertion, lookup, release, dispatch, and sink order verify end-to-end.

workstreams.mitigation: Split bounded reader acquisition from a verified slice parser and replace iterator/closure-heavy HashMap validation with indexed deterministic vectors.
workstreams.exit_criteria: Sequential, random-access, embedded, graph, profiles, retention, and page lifecycle parsing verify end-to-end.

workstreams.mitigation: Consume verified bitmap mutation contracts and replace generic decoder callbacks with a concrete arithmetic/MMR decoder enum.
workstreams.exit_criteria: Pattern slicing, gray planes, skip generation, and rendering directly verify.

workstreams.mitigation: Use the planned verified FallibleVec wrapper.
workstreams.exit_criteria: parse_profiles directly verifies allocation and exact length.

workstreams.mitigation: Use verified FallibleVec and prove long/short retention extraction over the allocated result.
workstreams.exit_criteria: RetentionFlags::from_bytes, parse_referred_segments, and parse_segment_header directly verify.

workstreams.mitigation: Use verified FallibleVec, explicit allocation-size lemmas, and slice-view adapters for static standard tables.
workstreams.exit_criteria: Canonical table construction and custom/standard table factories directly verify.

workstreams.mitigation: Replace RefCell/dynamic callbacks with a concrete entropy-state enum, adopt verified FallibleVec, and use completed bitmap/generic contracts.
workstreams.exit_criteria: Arithmetic and Huffman dictionary/text payload decoders directly verify end-to-end.

workstreams.mitigation: Use verified FallibleVec/slice adapters and concrete arithmetic callbacks; finish Bitmap::blank/filled contracts first.
workstreams.exit_criteria: Generic/refinement headers, sessions, snapshots, marker handling, and raster loops directly verify.
workstreams.investigation: Resolved: Verus 0.2026.10.04.426d8b0 plus indexed parser-state loops directly verifies both composed header parsers without the former rustc generic_args panic.

workstreams.mitigation: Use verified transition storage and Bitmap allocation contracts, then close decode_bitmap and its wrappers.
workstreams.exit_criteria: MMR bitmap/prefix entry points directly verify deterministic output.

workstreams.mitigation: Use pinned-vstd's existing Vec::try_reserve specification while preserving explicit allocation errors; prove initialization and layout.
workstreams.exit_criteria: Bitmap::blank and Bitmap::filled directly verify without broad assumptions.
